tables.name: Master Flooring Catalogue
tables.description: Source of truth for all Titan flooring products. Feeds Bert's pricing lookups, Cowork automation, and Lightspeed uploads. Do not edit pricing manually — use supplier price lists via Cowork.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Primary key. Format: CAT-SUPP-0001 e.g. ENG-VIDR-0042. Unique across all products. Used by Bert for all lookups.

fields.name: Product name
fields.description: Human-readable name including colour. e.g. Vidar 7in AWO — Macaroon

fields.name: Brand
fields.description: The product brand — may differ from supplier. e.g. BOEN sold by Canadian Standard

fields.name: Supplier
fields.description: Which supplier this product comes from

fields.name: Supplier SKU
fields.description: Supplier's own product code. Cowork uses this to match incoming price lists. e.g. VS081, TFSPC601-F

fields.name: Lightspeed ID
fields.description: Lightspeed internal ID. Background reference only. Populated after LS upload. Not required for Bert lookups.

fields.name: LS Handle / Parent ID
fields.description: Lightspeed parent handle that groups grade variants (e.g. Character / Select / Select & Better) under one product. Used by Vidar and similar graded suppliers.

fields.name: Collection
fields.description: Product line or series name. e.g. Regal Plus, Monte Rosa, Lucid 7, Scandinavia

fields.name: Product type
fields.description: Top-level product type. Determines which fields are relevant for this record.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Flooring category. Used by Bert to filter and recommend products.

fields.name: Material type
fields.description: Core material. More specific than category. e.g. Porcelain, marble, granite, HDF, SPC core, vinyl.

fields.name: Species
fields.description: Wood species. Engineered and solid hardwood only.

fields.name: Colour / tone
fields.description: General colour tone. Used by Bert for aesthetic filtering.

fields.name: Grade
fields.description: Wood grade / quality tier. Vidar: Character, Select, Select & Better. Others: AB, ABC, ABCD, Rustic. Leave blank for non-graded suppliers.

fields.name: Layout pattern
fields.description: Plank or tile layout pattern. Standard is default — only populate if non-standard.

fields.name: Width (in)
fields.description: Plank or tile width in inches.

fields.name: Thickness (mm)
fields.description: Overall product thickness in mm.

fields.name: Wear layer (mil)
fields.description: Wear layer thickness standardised to mil. LVP / SPC only. e.g. 12, 20, 22. Critical for durability recommendations.

fields.name: Veneer / top layer (mm)
fields.description: Engineered hardwood only. Top veneer thickness in mm. e.g. 1.2, 2, 3, 4. Affects sanding potential and durability.

fields.name: Veneer cut type
fields.description: How the veneer is cut from the log. Affects grain appearance and stability.

fields.name: AC rating
fields.description: Laminate abrasion resistance rating. AC1 (light residential) to AC6 (heavy commercial).

fields.name: Finish type
fields.description: Surface finish type. Critical for Bert recommendations and tile/stone specifications.
choices: Ultra Reactive Finish European Stain Hand Crafted

fields.name: Install profile
fields.description: Edge and joint profile type. T&G = tongue and groove (nail/glue). Click = floating. Glue down / loose lay for vinyl.

fields.name: Install method
fields.description: How the product is physically installed. Separate from profile type.

fields.name: Locking system
fields.description: Click locking system brand/type. e.g. Valinge 5G, 2G Drop Lock, UniPush, I4F, MegaLoc. Affects install ease and floating floor performance.

fields.name: Underpad included
fields.description: Whether an underpad is pre-attached to the product. If yes, populate Underpad type.

fields.name: Underpad type
fields.description: Type of attached underpad. Leave blank if Underpad included is unchecked.

fields.name: IIC rating
fields.description: Impact Insulation Class. Critical for condo installs. Many buildings require IIC 72 minimum.

fields.name: STC rating
fields.description: Sound Transmission Class. Paired with IIC for condo and multi-unit building compliance.

fields.name: Tile format
fields.description: Tile and stone only. Whether the tile is intended for wall, floor, mosaic or decorative use.

fields.name: Weight per piece (kg)
fields.description: Tile and stone only. Weight per piece in kg. Useful for delivery and install planning.

fields.name: Certifications
fields.description: Environmental and safety certifications. Select all that apply.

fields.name: Cost/unit
fields.description: Your cost from supplier per sq ft. Updated by Cowork when a new price list is processed. Never edit manually.

fields.name: Retail price/unit
fields.description: Your selling price per sq ft. This is what Bert quotes to customers and staff.

fields.name: MAP price ($/sf)
fields.description: Minimum Advertised Price set by supplier. Grandeur and some others enforce this. Bert should not quote below this.

fields.name: Pallet price ($/sf)
fields.description: Full skid / pallet price per sq ft where supplier offers a volume discount.

fields.name: Promo cost ($/sf)
fields.description: Active promotional price per sq ft. Bert quotes this instead of retail when populated. Cowork clears this when Promo end date passes.

fields.name: Promo end date
fields.description: Date the promotional price expires. Cowork clears Promo price ($/sf) automatically when this date passes.

fields.name: Volume pricing notes
fields.description: Tiered or volume pricing rules that don't fit in a single field. e.g. Sunshiny: dealer $3.89 / deposit $25k: $3.74 / deposit $50k: $3.59. Vidar: cut order $1.39 / 1-5 skids $1.34 / 6-20 skids $1.29.

fields.name: Last price update
fields.description: Date this product's cost or retail price was last updated. Bert flags records where this is older than 90 days as potentially stale.

fields.name: Price last changed by
fields.description: Who last updated the pricing. Audit trail.

fields.name: Box size (sf)
fields.description: Square footage per box. Used for quote calculations — how many boxes does a customer need?

fields.name: Pieces per box
fields.description: Number of planks or tiles per box.

fields.name: Boxes per skid
fields.description: Number of boxes per skid/pallet. Used for bulk order calculations and flagging minimum order quantities.

fields.name: Pieces per pallet
fields.description: Tile and stone only. Total pieces per pallet. Useful for large commercial orders.

fields.name: Stock status
fields.description: Current inventory status. Bert never recommends discontinued or clearance products as primary options.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Uncheck to archive a product. Bert only surfaces active products. Cowork auto-unchecks when supplier marks a product discontinued.

fields.name: Waterproof
fields.description: 100% waterproof core. Key filter for kitchens, bathrooms, basements. SPC and WPC are typically waterproof; engineered and laminate vary.

fields.name: Pet friendly
fields.description: Scratch and claw resistant. Based on wear layer thickness and finish hardness. One of the most common customer filters.

fields.name: Radiant heat compatible
fields.description: Compatible with hydronic radiant heat systems. Critical for Canadian climate. Note: some grades are excluded e.g. Vidar rustic grade is not compatible.

fields.name: Traffic rating
fields.description: Expected foot traffic level this product is rated for. Bert uses this to avoid recommending light residential products for high-traffic areas.

fields.name: Suitable rooms
fields.description: Which rooms this product is suitable for. Bert uses this to filter recommendations based on customer's project location.

fields.name: Residential warranty (yrs)
fields.description: Residential warranty in years. e.g. Vidar engineered = 35 yr finish + lifetime structural. Enter the finish warranty here.

fields.name: Commercial warranty (yrs)
fields.description: Commercial warranty in years. Often shorter than residential. e.g. Vidar SPC = 8 yr light commercial.

fields.name: Salesperson notes
fields.description: Salesperson pairing tips, common objections, install quirks, and what this product sells well with. This is Bert's product-level intelligence — fill this from salesperson interviews.

fields.name: Pairs well with
fields.description: SKUs of products that pair well with this one. e.g. matching stair nosing, complementary tile, recommended underpad. Bert uses this for upsell recommendations.

fields.name: Internal notes
fields.description: Internal notes field. Use Salesperson notes for product-specific Bert knowledge.

fields.name: Attachment Summary
fields.description: An AI generated summary of the Attachments field. Upload files to Attachments to generate a summary.

tables.name: Price History Log v2
tables.description: Append-only pricing audit trail (rebuilt). Mirrors the original Price History Log schema plus an Entry type flag (Regular price change / Promo applied / Promo cleared) so promo and regular cost movements can be separated in analysis. Manual + Cowork rows. Created 2026-05-28 for Vidar June 2026 logging.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: SKU of the product whose price/promo changed.

fields.name: Product name
fields.description: Human-readable product name (denormalized for quick reading).

fields.name: Entry type
fields.description: Regular price change = Cost/Retail moved. Promo applied = promo cost active/end-date set. Promo cleared = promo removed/expired.

fields.name: Previous cost ($/sf)
fields.description: Cost per unit before this change.

fields.name: New cost ($/sf)
fields.description: Cost per unit after this change. On Promo applied rows this holds the promo cost (see Entry type to distinguish).

fields.name: Promo cost ($/sf)
fields.description: Promo cost recorded on this row, if any.

fields.name: Promo end date
fields.description: Promo expiry recorded on this row, if any.

fields.name: Change date
fields.description: Date this change was recorded.

fields.name: Supplier
fields.description: Supplier whose price list drove the change.

fields.name: Changed by
fields.description: Manual or Cowork.

fields.name: Price list reference
fields.description: Filename/identifier of the supplier document.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Context about this change.
